title: 世界宗教 Day 25：世俗化与信仰的未来
title_en: World Religions Day 25: Secularization & the Future of Faith

questions.question: 把「世俗化」拆成制度分化、个人信仰衰退、宗教私人化三条主张后，哪一条在全球范围内站得最稳？
options: 宗教人口占世界人口的份额持续稳定下降
宗教与政治、法律、教育等领域在制度上分家
个人的信仰与宗教实践随现代化普遍减少
宗教退出公共议题，转为纯粹的私人事务
questions.explanation: 三条主张中只有制度分化在全球站得住。个人衰退主要发生在西欧，1979 年以来多处发展否定了它作为普遍规律；私人化则被宗教重回公共议题的「去私人化」直接反驳。份额下降也不成立：由于生育率与年龄结构，宗教人口份额未来可能回升。
questions.question_en: Once 'secularization' is split into institutional differentiation, decline of individual belief, and privatization of religion, which claim holds up best worldwide?
options_en: Religious people make up a steadily shrinking share of the world population
Religion has separated institutionally from politics, law and education
Individual belief and practice decline generally as societies modernize
Religion withdraws from public debate and becomes a purely private matter
questions.explanation_en: Only differentiation holds globally. Individual decline happened mainly in Western Europe and was refuted as a universal law by developments since 1979; privatization is contradicted by 'deprivatization', religion's return to public issues. A falling religious share doesn't hold either: fertility and age structure may push it back up.

questions.question: 某国调查显示「无宗教归属」比例十年里明显上升。由此最稳妥的推论是什么？
options: 更多人不认宗教机构的标签，但未必不信神
信仰没变，下降的只是去宗教场所的频率
无神论者占人口的比例大致以同样幅度上升了
该国宗教与政治、教育之间的制度分化正在退潮
questions.explanation: 「无归属」是用否定定义的类别，量的是与宗教机构的关系，不是世界观：美国无归属者中约七成信神或某种更高力量，严格的无信仰者只占约五分之一。认同、信念、实践是三层不同的东西，任何一层的数字都不能替另外两层说话，所以既不能当作无神论者增长，也不能断言只是实践下降而信念不变。
questions.question_en: Surveys in a country show the share of 'religiously unaffiliated' rising markedly over a decade. What is the safest conclusion?
options_en: More people reject an institutional label, though many may still believe in God
Belief is unchanged; only attendance at places of worship has dropped
The share of atheists in the population has risen by roughly the same amount
The institutional separation of religion from politics and education is receding
questions.explanation_en: 'Unaffiliated' is defined negatively: it measures a relationship to institutions, not a worldview. About 70% of unaffiliated Americans believe in God or a higher power, and strict nonbelievers are only about a fifth. Identity, belief and practice are separate layers, and a number for one cannot speak for the others, so it neither means atheism grew nor proves that belief stayed put while only practice fell.

questions.question: 全球无宗教归属者十年里增加了约 2.7 亿，但其占世界人口的份额未来几十年反而可能下降。主要原因是什么？
options: 新的统计口径会把大量民间信仰者重新计入宗教人口
改宗方向正在逆转，从无归属转入宗教的人开始多于流出
许多无归属者到晚年会回到童年所属的宗教传统
无归属者年龄偏大、生育率偏低，份额被人口结构拉回
questions.explanation: 份额的变动主要由人口学决定：无归属者年龄偏大、生育率偏低，2055–60 年出生的婴儿预计只有约 9% 生于无归属母亲，所以即使改宗持续单向流向无归属，宗教人口份额也未必下降。改宗的实际方向恰恰是流向无归属，并没有逆转。
questions.question_en: The global unaffiliated population grew by about 270 million in a decade, yet its share of the world population may fall in coming decades. Why?
options_en: New counting methods will reclassify many folk-religion practitioners as religious
Switching has reversed, with more people now moving from no affiliation into a religion
Many unaffiliated people return to the religion of their childhood in later life
The unaffiliated skew older and have fewer children, pulling their share down
questions.explanation_en: Shares are driven mainly by demography: the unaffiliated are older and have fewer children, and only about 9% of babies born in 2055–60 are projected to have unaffiliated mothers. So even with switching flowing steadily toward no affiliation, the religious share need not fall. Switching has not reversed; it still runs toward the unaffiliated.
